catalyst_text: Announced positive interim responder analysis and DSMB confirmation
detailed_catalyst_text: An early go decision was reached in the Phase 3 CAPTIVATE trial for Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy based on a predefined interim responder analysis, achieving the target of at least 20 confirmed responders before 40 participants completed Part A. An independent DSMB confirmed the decision, and no related serious infections, autoimmune activation symptoms, serious adverse events, or discontinuations were observed. These findings support continuation of the pivotal study and strengthen the program’s risk-benefit profile.
catalyst_text_evidence: "Dianthus Therapeutics, Inc. ... today announced an early GO decision based on an interim responder analysis in the Phase 3 CAPTIVATE trial of claseprubart in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP)." "This GO decision was reached early, after 20 confirmed responders were achieved with less than 40 planned participants completing Part A of the trial." "There have been no related serious infections, no clinical symptoms of autoimmune activation, no related serious adverse events or discontinuations." "The GO decision was confirmed by an independent DSMB review."

catalyst_text: First subject dosed Phase 1 topline results 2H26
detailed_catalyst_text: A Phase 1 clinical trial reported successful dosing of the first subject. The two-part study includes healthy volunteers and patients with systemic lupus erythematosus to assess safety, tolerability, and PK/PD. This marks clinical initiation of the program and enables early human safety readouts.
catalyst_text_evidence: "today announced the first subject has been successfully dosed in the Phase 1 clinical trial of LBL-047 (DNTH212)" "This two-part, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, dose-escalation (single ascending dose) Phase 1 trial is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability and PK/PD of LBL-047 (DNTH212) in healthy volunteers (Part A) and patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (Part B)."

catalyst_text: Positive top-line data from Ph2 trial reported. End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting planned.
The FDA approved the IND, and the Phase 2 trial commenced on June 12, 2024.
